Water Systems Ventilation Systems Ductwork & Pipin           HVAC Technical Office Engineer Job Title: HVAC Technical Office Engineer Experience: 3 – 5 Years Department: Technical Office Field: HVAC / Mechanical Engineering Job Purpose To provide technical and commercial support for HVAC projects, including tender study, quantity take-off, heat load calculations, shop drawings, material submittals, technical evaluations, and preparation of competitive quotations based on the company's approved pricing and cost structure. Key Responsibilities Prepare accurate Quantity Take-Offs for HVAC works based on project drawings, specifications, and BOQ. Perform Heat Load Calculations and determine the required capacities of HVAC equipment. Prepare and review HVAC Shop Drawings , ensuring compliance with project requirements, specifications, and approved designs. Prepare Material Submittals and technical documentation for HVAC equipment and materials. Study new tenders and thoroughly review all project documents, including: Tender Drawings. Specifications. BOQ. Scope of Work. Project Requirements. Compare tender drawings, BOQ, and specifications to identify discrepancies, missing items, design conflicts, and unclear requirements. Prepare Technical Queries / RFIs whenever clarification is required. Prepare HVAC technical and commercial quotations based on the company's approved pricing and cost structure. Coordinate with the Procurement Department and suppliers to obtain equipment and material quotations. Review and technically evaluate supplier quotations and ensure compliance with project requirements. Prepare Technical & Commercial Comparison Sheets for equipment and materials. Evaluate alternative technical solutions and prepare Value Engineering (VE) proposals to optimize project cost and technical performance. Review HVAC designs and ensure compliance with applicable standards and codes such as ASHRAE, SMACNA, SBC , and project specifications. Coordinate with Project, Procurement, and Execution teams to ensure accurate quantities, technical requirements, and pricing. Prepare technical reports, cost breakdowns, and other documents required by management. Provide technical support to the Projects and Execution teams during project implementation, including responding to technical queries and reviewing design modifications. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering , preferably Mechanical Power Engineering or equivalent. 3–5 years of experience in HVAC Technical Office activities. Strong experience in tender analysis and HVAC quotation preparation. Good experience in HVAC quantity take-off. Good knowledge of heat load calculations and HVAC equipment selection. Strong ability to read and understand HVAC drawings, specifications, and BOQs. Good experience in preparing and reviewing Shop Drawings. Proficiency in AutoCAD . Knowledge of HAP or similar HVAC load calculation software is preferred. Good knowledge of: DX Systems VRF Systems Chilled Water Systems Ventilation Systems Ductwork & Piping Good knowledge of HVAC equipment and material pricing in the Saudi market. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet tender submission deadlines. Good communication and coordination skills.
